name: passive_skill_slots
source: Blizzard Game Guide quoted verbatim on the official Blizzard forums https://eu.forums.blizzard.com/en/d3/t/is-there-any-way-to-get-more-than-four-passive-skills/4446 post 5 - "That's four in total."; corroborated by Diablo Wiki https://diablo.fandom.com/wiki/Passive_skill_(Diablo_III). Sourced by Gemini, docs/research/literal-audit-sources-2.md row 23
notes: Audit row 23. Four at level 70; a fifth needs a Hellfire Amulet and is not a slot the character has
